include.domain_definition: Extrema on scored held-out samples after initial-state prefix; empirical coverage, not full-state or stability certification

criteria.rationale: Prospective engineering accuracy targets: 5-deg RMS is one third of the planned 15-deg reference increment; 3-deg bias is one fifth; 15-deg peak permits one increment of transient prediction error. These are declared accuracy targets, not universal stability/safety margins. Failure remains a finding; no post-data relaxation. Positive-command scoring prevents long quiet returns from concealing error. No automatic human control approval.
criteria.validation_scope: Accuracy applies to the full identified rig predictor (static map plus actuator lag), not to the nominal second-order DOB inverse or a robust-stability guarantee.
criteria.frozen_by: Revision protocol prepared under Martin Dodek's experimental authorization

nominal_inverse_scope: The controller and DOB use the original two-state pendulum inverse in calibrated input u. The identified actuator lag is included in physical prediction/validation only, not inverted or cancelled by a new controller. Calibration/model errors, actuator lag, quantization and other unmeasured effects remain equivalent disturbances.
